answer: Sybil attacks flood a network with fake identities. Resist by binding identity to ongoing work, not one-time signup. Treat each identity like a comet: visible, leaving a measurable trail on a public ledger peers cross-check. A fake cannot fake an ocean of real work, so its trail stays shallow and isolated. Spread mining rewards across epochs so flooding never pays back the compute. Reputation grows layer by layer like a pearl; only genuine effort builds it. Ongoing work, a public ledger, and delayed rewards make mass sybils cost more than any benefit they capture.
